root_cause: The browser gate clicks the weekly-review route and then waits for .review-layout. The cycle-3 implementation intentionally converts that layout into the condensed .ux-signoff-desk and calls layout.remove() as part of the successful transformation. Therefore the test waits for an element whose absence is an intended postcondition; a correctly functioning cycle-3 transform can make the test time out.

correlation.earlier_failure: An earlier cycle-3 verifier incorrectly expected a standalone /app/public/ux-reset-cycle3.js even though the approved composition appends the UX layer into value-cockpit-ui.js and factory-control-ui.css.
correlation.recurring_pattern: The cycle-3 proof harness has repeatedly asserted pre-composition implementation details rather than durable post-composition behavior. Both failures occurred after the exact sealed runtime build remained intact.

machine_readable_detection_rules.static_rule: If a browser gate waits for selector S after invoking the transform and the implementation deliberately removes S in that successful transform, classify the gate as contradictory and fail the test definition review before runtime execution.

safe_regression_scenario: Build the exact composed image and verify runtime SHA-256 before browser execution.
Navigate and authenticate only in the isolated fixture environment.
Wait for the durable semantic postcondition .ux-signoff-desk, not the transient pre-transform .review-layout.
Assert exactly three .ux-signoff-detail sections, no legacy hero, no page-level horizontal overflow, and required KPI labels.
Assert the sealed server contract and runtime artifact remain unchanged.
If the durable postcondition does not appear, capture page/role/overlay globals and browser console errors before classifying a product defect.

collision_avoidance.reason: PR 37 was actively receiving commits while the defect was diagnosed. This branch preserves the validated cause without editing the active owner's UX implementation or workflow.

claim_boundary: This finding is confined to a draft UX proof harness. It does not demonstrate a staging outage, product defect, tenant-isolation failure, payroll mutation, production exposure or customer-data impact.
